caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil on a light beige paper. At the center of the composition, there is a detailed illustration of a cylindrical metallic mug with a rounded handle attached to its right side. The mug appears plain and reflective, showing subtle shading to convey its three-dimensional form. Encasing the mug, there is a larger outlined rectangle, within which the other elements are arranged. In the upper right corner, a smaller outlined square contains a decorative emblem above the stylized script initials "CM." In the lower left corner, another outlined square displays a technical side-view diagram of the mug, including measurements indicated with dotted lines, labels, and small arrows. The paper exhibits some aging around the edges, particularly a light brown discoloration at the borders and a faint rectangular mark in the top left corner. In the lower right corner of the primary outlined rectangle, the name “Marie Lanneray” is written in small script. The entire image consists of fine pencil lines and cross-hatching, with no presence of color beyond the inherent shading of the pencil on paper.
title: Silver Cup
